use: The cavalry's horse lines, beyond the board.

generator.prompt: A Roman cavalry picket line in an army field camp, empty: a long tether rope stretched between two stout wooden posts, a wooden feed trough on trestles beneath it, a heap of hay, a wooden water bucket, and two leather four-horned saddles resting on a timber rail. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and strong readable silhouette, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.

review.scope: Tripo's own render, four views of the final compressed model with a 1.8 m figure for scale (scripts/assets/preview-model.mjs), and the camps in the desktop build at High
review.notes: Two posts with a picket rope, a trough on trestles, hay, a bucket and saddles, on a plank standing the negative prompt did not keep out. The raw model's saddles carry small metal loops like stirrups, which the cavalry of the period did not have; at 2,940 triangles they no longer read as loops, and the saddles read as leather shapes with pale horns.
